# temporal_nexus_endpoint (Data Source)

Temporal Nexus Endpoint data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get data of the example Nexus endpoint
data "temporal_nexus_endpoint" "example" {
  name = "example-worker"
}

output "example_nexus_endpoint_id" {
  value = data.temporal_nexus_endpoint.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Endpoint name, unique within the cluster

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Endpoint description in Markdown
- `external_target` (Attributes) Set when requests are routed to an external Nexus server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_target))
- `id` (String) Server-generated endpoint identifier
- `url_prefix` (String) Server URL path prefix for invoking operations on this endpoint. It does not change when the endpoint is renamed
- `version` (Number) Data version of the endpoint, incremented by the server on every update
- `worker_target` (Attributes) Set when requests are routed to a task queue polled by Nexus workers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--worker_target))

<a id="nestedatt--external_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_target`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) URL to call


<a id="nestedatt--worker_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `worker_target`

Read-Only:

- `namespace` (String) Namespace to route requests to
- `task_queue` (String) Nexus task queue to route requests to
